decky_shortcut_restored_dupes: Toast after 'Recreate library shortcut'. {count}: duplicate library entries it removed.
decky_game_shortcuts_none: Toast after 'Remove game shortcuts' found none.
decky_game_shortcuts_removed: Toast after 'Remove game shortcuts'. {count}: how many it removed.
decky_no_stream: Toast when a host-menu button finds no stream.
decky_stream_unreachable: Toast when a host-menu button could not talk to the running stream.
decky_client_unreachable_end: Toast when ending a game could not reach the client.
decky_game_ended: Toast after 'End game'. {title}: the game's name.
decky_host_trusted: A host's trust state in the panel's host line: its identity is pinned, not yet paired.
decky_host_needs_access: Panel section heading over the hosts this device has to be let into first.
decky_host_connect: Controller legend on a host row this device is not let into yet: opens the trust sheet.
decky_stream: Controller legend on a host row in the panel: start the stream.
decky_section_client_update: Panel section heading when only a client update waits and this device cannot install it itself.
decky_newer_version: Stand-in label when the client's new version number is unknown.
decky_section_update: Panel section heading when an update can be installed here.
decky_update_plugin: Label of the update button. {current}, {latest}: version numbers.
decky_update_plugin_client: Label of the update button when the tap also installs the client. {current}, {latest}: version numbers.
decky_update_client_only: Label of the update button when only the client updates.
decky_section_hosts: Panel section heading over the host list.
decky_scanning: The refresh button while the host list is scanning.
decky_problem_not_installed: Panel line when the Punktfunk app is missing.
decky_problem_scan_failed: Panel line when the scan failed.
decky_problem_outdated: Panel line when the client is too old.
decky_problem_not_installed_body: Explains the missing app. 'Desktop Mode' is SteamOS's desktop.
decky_problem_scan_failed_body: Explains the failed scan. 'Refresh' is the panel's button: use its label.
decky_scanning_network: Panel line while the first scan runs.
decky_open_app: Panel button: open the Punktfunk app's console home.
decky_play_menu: Panel toggle: list hosts in the menu beside a game's Play button.
decky_play_menu_hint: Line under the toggle. 'Play' is Steam's button and 'Stream' its new label: use the labels Steam and this plugin show.
decky_host_steam_menu_hint: Line under 'Steam menu on host'. Names the host's button the plugin presses, not the one in your hand.
decky_host_steam_menu: Panel button while a stream runs.
decky_host_qam: Panel button while a stream runs.
decky_end_game_hint: Line under 'End game'. {title}: the game's name.
decky_end_game_confirm_title: Confirm dialog title. {title}: the game's name.
decky_section_about: Panel section heading: the plugin's version and the update check.
decky_section_troubleshooting: Panel section heading over the repair buttons: Force-stop, Recreate library shortcut, Remove game shortcuts.
decky_version_dev: Plugin version line for a build from no channel. {version}: the version number.
decky_checking: Button while an update check runs.
decky_remove_game_shortcuts_hint: Line under 'Remove game shortcuts'. 'Stream' is the game page's button.
decky_force_stop: Panel button: kill a stream that hangs.
decky_trust_refused: Trust sheet error. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_outdated: Trust sheet error when the client is too old.
decky_client_unreachable: Trust sheet and PIN keypad error when the client did not answer.
decky_trust_save_failed: Trust sheet error. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_approve_toast: Toast while the access request waits. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_denied: Trust sheet error after the access request ended without approval. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_title: Trust sheet heading. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_no_identity: Trust sheet line for a host added by address.
decky_trust_open_host: Trust sheet line for a host that takes new devices. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_needs_approval: Trust sheet line. {host}: the host's name.
decky_use_pin: Trust sheet button: open the PIN keypad.
decky_trust_request_hint: Trust sheet footer, under the Request access button. {host}: the host's name.
decky_pair_unreachable: PIN keypad error. {host}: the host's name.
decky_pair_outdated: PIN keypad error when the client is too old.
decky_pair_failed: PIN keypad error, any other cause.
decky_boundary_title: Shown in place of the plugin's panel after a display error.
decky_waking_to_stream: Toast when a game page streams from a sleeping host. {host}: its name; {title}: the game's name.
decky_catalog_title: Toast title the first time a host's games arrive. {host}: its name.
decky_catalog_ready: Toast body under 'Stream from {host}'. {count}: how many of the host's games Steam knows. A Decky toast clips past about forty characters.
decky_host_asleep: After a host's name in Steam's 'Play from' menu: the host is asleep. Lower case: it follows ' · '.
decky_host_awake: Toast after 'Wake host' in a host's menu, once the host answers. {host}: its name.
decky_play_stream: Steam's Play button on a game page, relabelled while a Punktfunk host is picked.
decky_play_stop: Steam's Play button on a game page while its Punktfunk stream runs, and the panel's button that ends the running stream.
decky_update_available_plugin: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {current}, {latest}: plugin versions; {version}: the client's new version.
decky_update_available_client: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {current}, {latest}: plugin versions; {version}: the client's new version.
decky_update_available_client_unknown: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {current}, {latest}: plugin versions; {version}: the client's new version.
decky_update_available_both: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {current}, {latest}: plugin versions; {version}: the client's new version.
decky_update_available_both_unknown: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {current}, {latest}: plugin versions; {version}: the client's new version.
decky_update_client_manual_note: Second sentence after 'Update available: …' when this device cannot install the client itself.
decky_up_to_date: Toast after 'Check for updates'. {version}: the plugin's version.
decky_client_manual_command: Toast after a client update. {command}: the shell command that updates it.
decky_client_update_failed: Toast after a client update failed.
decky_client_updating_slow: Toast while a packaged client updates.
decky_client_update_run: Toast when this device cannot install the client. {version}: the new version; {command}: the shell command that does.
decky_client_update_manual: Toast when this device cannot install the client and knows no command. {version}: the new version.
decky_plugin_updating: Toast while Decky installs the new plugin. {version}: its version.
decky_plugin_update_manual: Toast when the plugin cannot update itself. 'Developer' and 'Install Plugin from URL' are Decky's own menu items, in English.
decky_launch_failed: Toast when a stream did not start.
decky_launch_failed_named: Toast when a stream did not start. {name}: the profile's or the game's name.
decky_launch_failed_preset: Toast when a pinned card's stream did not start. {preset}: the preset's name; the quotes are this language's.
decky_end_game_unresolved: Toast when the panel lost track of the streamed game.
decky_trust_request_failed: Trust sheet error when the access request failed with no reason given. {host}: the host's name.
decky_trust_bad_fingerprint: Trust sheet error when the identity the host advertised is malformed. {host}: the host's name.
